max_proximity_baseline.purpose: Distance beyond which proximity score reaches 0.0

duration_saturation_frames.purpose: Duration beyond which duration score saturates at 1.0

secondary_zone_definition_gate.purpose: Exclude events with undefined secondary zone from CANDIDATE_BACKFIRE

scoring_equation.mathematical_implication: Score >= 0.60 mathematically requires min_pixel_distance <= 400.0 px. Duration alone can never exceed 0.40.

anomalous_high_score_events.v3_4_e_finding: Both agents cleared corridor safely with zero secondary hazard
Vehicle stopped completely (disp 2.5px) with zero secondary hazard

negative_control_behavior.interpretation: Descriptive negative control behavior proves that high spatial proximity (< 230 px) caused the generator to produce candidate scores >= 0.60 even when the physical interaction resolved safely with zero secondary risk transfer.

candidate_score_vs_secondary_zone_observ.finding: High candidate scores occur indiscriminately in zones where secondary depth is unobservable (PARTIAL).

candidate_score_vs_causal_sequence_obser.finding: Candidate scores >= 0.60 were assigned to events with broken causal sequences (e.g. 027_003 track handoff, 026_014 clutter) because generator ignored causal continuity.

confirmed_findings: Candidate generator relies exclusively on 2 features: minimum 2D Euclidean footpoint distance (60%) and co-occurrence duration (40%).
Zero secondary-risk features are implemented (SECONDARY_RISK_FEATURE = NOT_IMPLEMENTED).
Zero causal chain requirements exist (CAUSAL_CHAIN_REQUIREMENT = ABSENT).
Post-event window evidence is not used in score calculation (POST_EVIDENCE_NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_CANDIDACY = TRUE).
The generator mathematically cannot distinguish between a near-miss stopped safely and an evasive backfire cascade.
limitations: Audit evaluated existing codebase implementations without executing retraining or parameter tuning.
All findings describe candidate generator heuristic mechanics, not physical safety ground truth.
